messages.author: Gustaf Olsson
messages.body:
>From what I can see it is the "diff" that fails, comparing the output of the test with the reference and not the actual execution of the test.
This would indicate that the problem is more likely related to your system or configuration and not the installation of amber.
Text file busy
Seems to indicate the diff/test not being able to access the necessary files. Have you set $AMBERHOME correctly? Have you installed anything using "sudo" or "su/root"?
// Gustaf
